theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_sd_open_ladder
theorems.statement: ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (n : ℕ) (Q : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ), IsOpen U → (∀ (r : ℕ), r < n → ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt (Q r) (-Q (r + 1) z) z) → (∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt (Q n) (g z) z) → ∀ z ∈ U, iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (Q 0) z = (-1 : ℂ) ^ n * g z
theorems.natural_summary: Inductively identify the r-th iterated derivative with (−1)^r Q_r on U for r≤n. Openness supplies neighborhood equality, allowing derivative transfer at each step. Apply the terminal derivative hypothesis at r=n. This matches the supplied prose, includes n=0, and imposes no assumptions outside U.
